data.name: SRB - SALCO's ROAMING BOTS
data.teaser: Let bots leave their comfort zones.
data.description:
Overview

Bots in SPT often remain close to their spawn areas, repeating the same short patrols and leaving large parts of the map feeling empty.

SRB – Salco’s Roaming Bots encourages eligible bots to leave those familiar areas and travel across the map. When a bot has nothing more important to do, SRB selects a distant, reachable destination and sends it there. After a short pause, the bot can continue toward another area.

This creates less predictable encounters and gives bots a reason to appear along connecting routes, inside distant locations, and in areas that would otherwise remain quiet.

SRB does not replace combat AI. Combat, danger, healing, and other important actions always take priority. When a bot encounters an enemy or comes under fire, SRB gives control back to the bot’s normal combat behavior.

The mod is deliberately focused on one task: making idle bots move around the map.

Features
  • Sends eligible bots toward distant locations across the map
  • Uses dynamically selected destinations instead of fixed patrol points
  • Only accepts destinations with a complete NavMesh route
  • Automatically yields to combat, danger, healing, and higher-priority AI
  • Keeps groups together by assigning distant targets to group leaders by default
  • Avoids recently visited destinations
  • Discourages multiple roaming bots from selecting the same area
  • Detects bots that are no longer making progress and assigns a new destination
  • Distributes path calculations over multiple frames
  • Includes configurable limits to keep resource usage low
  • Provides a compact activity report at the end of each raid
  • Includes an optional debug free camera for observing bots across the map
  • Can be configured through the BepInEx F12 menu

SRB does not:

  • Change bot equipment or progression
  • Change bot spawn numbers
  • Replace combat behavior
  • Simulate quests
  • Make bots loot containers or corpses
  • Force bots to extract
  • Teleport stuck bots
  • Unlock inaccessible doors
How It Works

While a supported bot is idle and safe, SRB searches for a distant location on the expanded Waypoints NavMesh.

Several possible destinations are evaluated, but only complete routes are accepted. The bot then travels toward the selected destination using normal EFT movement.

SRB stops controlling the bot whenever a more important behavior takes over. This includes:

  • Combat
  • Recent gunfire or danger
  • Medical treatment
  • Higher-priority BigBrain layers
  • Group-following behavior
  • Other supported objective systems

After the situation is safe again, SRB waits for the configured post-combat cooldown before selecting another destination.

By default, only solo bots and group leaders receive SRB destinations. Other group members remain under their usual follower behavior.

Comparison
Mod Main Purpose Difference from SRB
SRB Map-wide idle roaming Sends otherwise idle bots toward dynamically selected, distant destinations without assigning quests, loot objectives, or extraction goals.
Looting Bots Bot looting behavior Allows bots to search containers, corpses, loose items, and airdrops. Movement happens because the bot wants to loot something. SRB does not interact with loot.
Questing Bots Simulated quests and objectives Sends bots to real quest locations and can simulate planting items, holding areas, boss hunting, spawn rushing, and other objectives. SRB provides simpler, objective-free roaming.
ORBIT Full bot lifecycle and squad objectives Controls squad goals, looting, PvP hotspots, quest routing, coordination, and extraction. SRB is intentionally smaller and only controls idle roaming.
ABPS Bot spawning and placement Controls when, where, and how many bots, waves, PMCs, or bosses spawn. It does not determine where those bots travel after spawning.
APBS Bot progression and equipment Adjusts bot levels, weapons, ammunition, equipment, and progression tiers. It does not control bot navigation or roaming.

A simple way to separate these mods:

  • ABPS: Who spawns, where, and when?
  • APBS: What level and equipment does the bot have?
  • Looting Bots: What does the bot pick up?
  • Questing Bots: Which simulated quest does the bot perform?
  • ORBIT: What full raid lifecycle does the squad follow?
  • SRB: Where does an otherwise idle bot go next?
Compatibility

BigBrain and Waypoints

BigBrain and Waypoints are required dependencies.

  • BigBrain provides the AI-layer system used by SRB.
  • Waypoints provides the expanded NavMesh that allows bots to reach more areas.

SAIN

SRB is designed to leave combat behavior to SAIN or vanilla EFT.

SAIN controls how bots fight, react, take cover, and make combat decisions. SRB controls where eligible bots travel while they are not fighting.

Compatibility with the eventual SPT 4.1.x release of SAIN still requires real in-raid testing.

Looting Bots

Looting Bots and SRB are functionally complementary:

  • SRB provides general roaming.
  • Looting Bots provides loot-driven behavior.

Both use bot brain layers, so their final SPT 4.1.x versions must be tested together to confirm that layer priorities and handoffs work correctly.

Questing Bots

Questing Bots and SRB both want to assign long-distance destinations to bots.

To avoid two objective systems competing for control, SRB’s safe default behavior is to suspend roaming when Questing Bots is detected.

An experimental priority-based compatibility mode can be selected in the F12 menu.

ORBIT

ORBIT already controls squad movement, objectives, looting, quest routing, and extraction.

Running SRB and ORBIT simultaneously would duplicate destination control. SRB therefore suspends roaming by default when ORBIT is detected.

ABPS

ABPS controls bot spawning and placement, while SRB controls post-spawn roaming.

The two systems have very little functional overlap and are expected to work together. Version-specific testing will still be performed when an SPT 4.1.x release of ABPS becomes available.

APBS

APBS controls bot progression, levels, weapons, ammunition, and equipment.

It does not control bot movement, so it should not conflict with SRB’s roaming behavior. Version-specific testing will still be required for SPT 4.1.x.

Performance

SRB is designed to remain lightweight even when many bots are active.

  • Path searches are distributed over multiple frames
  • A global calculation budget is shared by every SRB bot
  • Expensive eligibility checks run at configurable intervals
  • Only a limited number of route candidates are evaluated
  • Completed targets are remembered to reduce repetitive movement
  • Detailed per-bot logging is disabled by default
  • Raid statistics use lightweight counters

During testing on Shoreline, SRB handled map-wide roaming with a very small pathfinding workload and without producing SRB, BigBrain, or Waypoints exceptions.

Debug Tools

SRB includes an optional observation camera for testing bot movement.

The free camera does not move the player entity. The player’s body remains at its original position and can still be seen, injured, or killed.

Default controls:

  • F9: Toggle the free camera
  • WASD: Move
  • Q / E: Move down or up
  • Left Shift: Speed boost
  • Esc: Release the mouse
  • Left Mouse Button: Capture the mouse again

The toggle key and movement speeds can be changed through the F12 menu.

Requirements
  • SPT 4.1.x
  • BigBrain
  • Waypoints
  • BepInEx

SRB is a client-side BepInEx plugin.

Install the DLL into:

BepInEx/plugins/SalcosRoamingBots/

Configuration

Settings are available through the BepInEx F12 configuration menu.

Most settings take effect immediately or during the next destination search.

Changing the BigBrain layer priority requires a game restart.

REPORT BUGS

There are two ways to report bugs:

  1. My own thread on Discord: https://discord.com/channels/875684761291599922/1521957836928848032
  2. In the ‘Issue’ tab on GitHub: https://github.com/S4LCO/SalcosRoamingBots/issues

IMPORTANT:

  1. I need a clean log.
  2. A list of your installed mods.

Bug reports without logs will be ignored.

SUPPORT ME

If you like the mod, feel free to send some donation. 🫶🏼

https://ko-fi.com/salco1

The default configuration is intended to provide long-distance roaming while remaining conservative about performance and compatibility.
